result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: one audit per 12 months, 30 days’ written notice, business-hours timing, an independent auditor subject to confidentiality, Vendor-paid costs absent underpayment above 5%, and no direct system access. It preserves the core audit and underpayment-recovery rights. However, the statement that Customer may satisfy an audit merely by providing usage records is an additional restriction not required by the playbook and could unnecessarily limit reasonable verification procedures. The drafting is otherwise professional, though the system-access prohibition is duplicated across Sections 22.1 and 22.2.
